region: The Nebular Kingdoms & Fifty Conquered Worlds

key_locations.name: Earth
key_locations.description: Ancient humanity's origin planet, mostly radioactive wasteland with patches of habitable land, home to the University of Earth and forgotten archives of pre-atomic history.

key_locations.name: Rhodia
key_locations.description: Wealthy, civilized agricultural and cultural center ruled by the Hinriad dynasty under Tyranni surveillance. Heart of covert archival preservation.

key_locations.name: Lingane
key_locations.description: Technologically advanced kingdom on the rim of the Horsehead Nebula, ruled by the Autarch Sander Jonti. Base of swift pirate cruisers and double-dealing conspiracies.

key_locations.name: Widemos
key_locations.description: Fierce pastoral world governed by the Ranchers of Widemos. Its leader was executed by Tyrann for treason, leaving Biron as the dispossessed heir.

key_locations.name: Tyrann
key_locations.description: Resource-poor, harsh desert planet whose Spartan warrior-caste conquered fifty neighboring kingdoms fifty years prior through military discipline and speed.

key_locations.name: The Horsehead Nebula
key_locations.description: A vast, impenetrable interstellar dust cloud where stellar radiation is veiled. Site of Gillbret's ancient shipwreck and the rumored coordinates of the Rebellion World.

ships.name: The Remembrance (formerly The Farrell)
ships.description: The vessel seized by Biron, Artemisia, and Gillbret during their escape from Rhodia. Secretly bugged with Aratap's sub-ether tracking device.

ships.name: The Autarch's Pride
ships.description: Sander Jonti's personal warship, equipped with advanced long-range hyper-radios and heavy blaster turrets.

ships.name: The Khan's Vengeance
ships.description: Commissioner Simok Aratap's command vessel, capable of hyperspace micro-jumps and orbital decimation.
